```{r}

prepare_data_hulten<-function(df,sector_tot_name){

GDP_CP<-
  df%>%
  filter(sector==sector_tot_name)%>%
  select(Year,geo_code,VA_CP)%>%
  rename("gdp_CP"="VA_CP")

# STAN
df_Hulten_temp<-
  df%>%
  rename(
    "Aihat" = "log_change_TFP_GO",
    "va_pi" = "VA_PI",
    "Ai"="TFP_GO",
    "country" = "geo_code"
  ) %>%
  group_by(country, sector) %>%
  mutate(Aihat = ifelse(Year == min(Year), 0, Aihat)) 

gTFP_tot<-
  df_Hulten_temp%>%
  filter(sector==sector_tot_name)%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  select(country,Year,log_change_TFP_VA, TFP_VA)%>%
  rename("agg_Ahat"="log_change_TFP_VA",
         "agg_A"="TFP_VA")

  df_Hulten<-
    df_Hulten_temp%>%
    filter(!sector==sector_tot_name)%>%
    left_join(gTFP_tot,by=c("country","Year"))%>%
    left_join(GDP_CP,by=c("country"="geo_code","Year"))%>%
    mutate(domar_weight=GO_CP/gdp_CP)%>%
    filter(!is.na(domar_weight))%>%
    filter( !is.na(gdp_CP))%>%
    filter(!is.na(agg_A))%>%
    filter(!is.na(Ai))

print(df_Hulten%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Year,y=agg_A))+
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~country))
# IE: becomes weirdly negative, SK grows weirdly fast, EL, almost negative,
  
  # countries
print("number countries")
print(n_distinct(df_Hulten$country))
unique(df_Hulten$country)

return(df_Hulten)}

```

```{r}
# Define the function to calculate growth rates for a given n
calculate_growth <- function(df, n) {
  df %>%
    group_by(country,sector)%>%
    arrange(country,sector,Year)%>%
    mutate(n_sector=row_number(Year))%>%
    mutate(
      Aihat = if_else(n_sector > n, log(Ai) - log(lag(Ai, n)), NA_real_),
      domar_weight_initial=if_else(n_sector > n, lag(domar_weight, n), NA_real_),
       domar_weight_final=if_else(n_sector > n, domar_weight, NA_real_),
      Ahat = if_else(n_sector > n, log(agg_A) - log(lag(agg_A, n)), NA_real_),
      horizon = n, # Add the horizon column indicating the value of n
      Year_initial=lag(Year,n)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Aihat))%>%
    # Ensure to select new columns including the horizon column
    select(Year, country, sector, sector_name, Aihat, Ahat,  horizon,domar_weight,domar_weight_initial,domar_weight_final,Year_initial) %>%
    ungroup()
}



compute_Agg_Ahat_errors<-function(df){
df%>%
  group_by(horizon, country, Year, Ahat) %>%
  summarise(
    pred_Ahat_2nd = sum((domar_weight_initial + domar_weight_final)/2 * Aihat),
    pred_Ahat_1st = sum(domar_weight_initial * Aihat),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("pred_Ahat_"),
    names_to = "aggregation_order",
    names_prefix = "pred_Ahat_",
    values_to = "pred_Ahat"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Ahat)) %>%
  group_by(horizon, aggregation_order) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_error = mean(pred_Ahat - Ahat),
    median_error = median(pred_Ahat - Ahat),
    q10 = quantile(pred_Ahat - Ahat, probs = 0.1),
    q25 = quantile(pred_Ahat - Ahat, probs = 0.25),
    q75 = quantile(pred_Ahat - Ahat, probs = 0.75),
    q90 = quantile(pred_Ahat - Ahat, probs = 0.9),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_error = transform_bp_into_pp(mean_error),
    median_error = transform_bp_into_pp(median_error),
    q10_pp = transform_bp_into_pp(q10),
    q25_pp = transform_bp_into_pp(q25),
    q75_pp = transform_bp_into_pp(q75),
    q90_pp = transform_bp_into_pp(q90)
  )
}

compute_agg_prod<-function(df){
  
   df%>%
    group_by(horizon, country, Year,Year_initial) %>%
  summarise(
    pred_Ahat_2nd = sum((domar_weight_initial + domar_weight_final) / 2 * Aihat),
    pred_Ahat_1st = sum(domar_weight_initial * Aihat),
    actual = first(Ahat)
  ) %>%
   distinct()%>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(pred_Ahat_1st, pred_Ahat_2nd, actual),
    names_to = "aggregation_order",
    names_pattern = "pred_Ahat_(1st|2nd)|actual",
    values_to = "pred_Ahat"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    aggregation_order = case_when(
      aggregation_order == "1st" ~ "1st",
      aggregation_order == "2nd" ~ "2nd",
      TRUE ~ "actual"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(horizon, country, Year,Year_initial, aggregation_order, pred_Ahat)%>%
  group_by(horizon, country, Year,aggregation_order)%>%
  mutate(cum_predAhat=cumsum(pred_Ahat))
}
 
```

```{r}
  filter(!is.na(Aihat))%>%
  distinct(country, sector) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(sector_set = paste(sort(unique(sector)), collapse = ",")) %>%

# Step 0: Define and parse your sets
set_A1 <- unlist(strsplit("A,B,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,J,K,L,M,N,O,P,Q,R,S", ","))
set_B1 <- unlist(strsplit("A,B,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,J,K,L,M-N,O,P,Q,R,S", ",")) 
# set_C1 <- unlist(strsplit("A,B,C,D-E,F,G,H,I,J,K,L,M,N,O,P,Q,R,S", ","))     
set_C1 <- unlist(strsplit("A,B,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,J,K,M,N,O,P,Q,R,S", ",")) #missing L
set_D1 <- unlist(strsplit("B,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,J,K,M,N,O,P,Q,R,S", ",")) #missing A,L
set_E1 <- unlist(strsplit("B,C,D-E,F,G,H,I,J,K,M,N,O,P,Q,R", ",")) #D-E, missing A, L, S (for the US) 


sector_sets_classified <- sector_sets %>%
  mutate(
    sector_vec = strsplit(sector_set, ","),
    classification = sapply(sector_vec, function(sectors) {
      if (all(set_A1 %in% sectors)) {
        "A1"
      } else if (all(set_B1 %in% sectors)) {
        "B1"
      } else if (all(set_C1 %in% sectors)) {
        "C1"
      } else if (all(set_D1 %in% sectors)) {
        "D1"
      } else if (all(set_E1 %in% sectors)) {
        "E1"
      } else {
        "other"
      }
    })
  )%>%
  select(country,classification)

sector_sets_classified%>%
  filter(!classification %in% c("A1","B1"))
```

How strong exactly is the argument that long-horizon Domar aggregation error distributions are much more poorly estimated? A simple diagnostic is the number of country-year aggregate error draws in each distribution as a function of horizon.

```{r}
build_hulten_error_distribution_counts <- function(df_growth_rate, db_name, aggregation_order_select = "1st") {
  counts <- df_growth_rate %>%
    group_by(horizon, country, Year, Year_initial, Ahat) %>%
    summarise(
      pred_Ahat_2nd = sum((domar_weight_initial + domar_weight_final) / 2 * Aihat),
      pred_Ahat_1st = sum(domar_weight_initial * Aihat),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("pred_Ahat_"),
      names_to = "aggregation_order",
      names_prefix = "pred_Ahat_",
      values_to = "pred_Ahat"
    ) %>%
    filter(aggregation_order == aggregation_order_select) %>%
    mutate(error = pred_Ahat - Ahat) %>%
    filter(!is.na(error), is.finite(error)) %>%
    group_by(horizon) %>%
    summarise(
      n_error_points = n(),
      n_countries = n_distinct(country),
      n_country_year_pairs = n_distinct(country, Year_initial, Year),
      n_start_years = n_distinct(Year_initial),
      n_end_years = n_distinct(Year),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(horizon)

  if (nrow(counts) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      db = db_name,
      horizon = numeric(),
      n_error_points = integer(),
      n_countries = integer(),
      n_country_year_pairs = integer(),
      n_start_years = integer(),
      n_end_years = integer(),
      n_error_points_h1 = integer(),
      share_of_h1 = numeric()
    ))
  }

  h1_count <- counts$n_error_points[counts$horizon == min(counts$horizon, na.rm = TRUE)][1]

  counts %>%
    mutate(
      db = db_name,
      n_error_points_h1 = h1_count,
      share_of_h1 = n_error_points / n_error_points_h1
    ) %>%
    select(db, everything())
}

df_error_distribution_counts_KLEMS_hulten <-
  build_hulten_error_distribution_counts(df_KLEMS_Hulten_growth_clean, "KLEMS")

df_error_distribution_counts_KLEMS_hulten_summary <-
  df_error_distribution_counts_KLEMS_hulten %>%
  summarise(
    n_h1 = first(n_error_points),
    n_h20 = n_error_points[match(20, horizon)],
    share_h20_vs_h1 = n_error_points[match(20, horizon)] / first(n_error_points),
    horizon_last = max(horizon, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_last = last(n_error_points),
    share_last_vs_h1 = last(share_of_h1)
  )

)
```

## Extend 1st order quantiles to 30 years

Function
```{r}
# Define a function to fit a linear model and predict new values
predict_new_horizons <- function(df, horizon_extend) {
  # Fit a linear model
  df_filtered <- df %>% filter(horizon > max(horizon)-10)
  model <- lm(value ~ horizon, data = df_filtered)
  # Create a new dataframe for prediction
  new_data <- tibble(horizon = (max(df$horizon) + 1):horizon_extend)
  # Predict values for new horizons
  predictions <- predict(model, newdata = new_data)
  # Return the new data with predictions
  return(new_data %>%
           mutate(predicted_value = predictions))
}
```


We need error et horizon 30
```{r}
# Extend the horizon for each quantile column
horizon_extend <- 30
hulten_error_distribution_empirical_cutoff <- 20


df_quantiles_error_KLEMS_hulten<-
  df_error_KLEMS_hulten%>%
  filter(aggregation_order=="1st")%>%
  select(horizon, mean_error, median_error, q10, q25, q75, q90)%>%
  rename("q50"="median_error")%>%
  pivot_longer(c(-horizon), names_to = "quantile", values_to = "value") 

df_quantiles_error_KLEMS_hulten_empirical <-
  df_quantiles_error_KLEMS_hulten %>%
  filter(horizon <= hulten_error_distribution_empirical_cutoff)

df_quantiles_hulten_extension <- 
  df_quantiles_error_KLEMS_hulten_empirical %>%
  group_by(quantile) %>%
  do(predict_new_horizons(., horizon_extend)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(is_extrapolated = TRUE)

# See the extended dataframe
```

```{r}

plot_hulten_hindcasting<-function(df,country_select,plot_legend=F,year_limits=NA){

  # Ahat and pred_Ahat_1st are already n-year cumulative growth (log(A[t])-log(A[t-n])),
  # so no cumsum needed. x-axis is horizon; join quantiles on horizon.

  if(is.na(year_limits[1])){
    
    df<-df%>%
      filter(country==country_select)%>%
      ungroup()%>%
      filter(year_initial==min(year_initial))
  }else{
    # year_limits[1] = year_initial (hindcast start year)
    # year_limits[2] = last year shown (max horizon = year_limits[2] - year_limits[1])
    df<-df%>%
      filter(country==country_select)%>%
      filter(year_initial==year_limits[1])%>%
      filter(year<=year_limits[2])
  }

  plot_country_hulten<-
    df%>%
    left_join(df_quantiles_hulten_extented,by=c("horizon"="horizon"))%>%
    ungroup()%>%
    mutate(q10_aihat=pred_Ahat_1st+q10,
           q25_aihat=pred_Ahat_1st+q25,
           q75_aihat=pred_Ahat_1st+q75,
           q90_aihat=pred_Ahat_1st+q90)%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=horizon))+
    facet_wrap(~country,scales="free")+
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=q10_aihat,ymax=q90_aihat,fill="[q10, q90]"),alpha=0.3)+
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=q25_aihat,ymax=q75_aihat,fill="[q25, q75]"),alpha=0.3)+
    geom_line(aes(y=Ahat,colour="True TFP growth"),lwd=1)+
    geom_line(aes(y=pred_Ahat_1st,colour="Predicted TFP growth"),lwd=1)+
    mytheme+
    scale_colour_manual(values=c("Predicted TFP growth"="#003f5c",
                                 "True TFP growth"="#fc8d62"))+
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("[q10, q90]"="lightblue",
                               "[q25, q75]"="navy"))+
    labs(fill="",colour="",y="",x="Horizon")+
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::number_format(scale=100,suffix='%'))+
    theme(legend.box="horizontal")
  if(plot_legend){return(plot_country_hulten)}else{
    return(plot_country_hulten+theme(legend.position="None"))
  }
}
```


In the UK, missing the real estate sector. 
A domar weight of about 17% (constant from 2002 to 2020)
See tables ONS, using P1 domestic production (SUT tables), in 2017: 320760 M£ (CP)
Total GVA (GDP, CP): 1860286
Domar weight: 0.172

MFP productivity growth for the UK L (real estate sector) has been 5 log points from 2001 to 2017 (included)
From quarterly MFP tables from the ONS. 
Hence, about 86bp. 

For comparison, total MFP growth from 2001 to 2017 in the MFP table is 1156bp (about 1000bp in KLEMS)

```{r,fig.height=5,fig.width=8}
countries_A1B1 <- sector_sets_classified %>%

# Self-contained geo_code -> geo_name lookup (covers all KLEMS + STAN countries)
geo_names <- c(
  AT="Austria", BE="Belgium", CZ="Czechia", DE="Germany", DK="Denmark",
  EE="Estonia", EL="Greece", ES="Spain", FI="Finland", FR="France",
  HU="Hungary", IT="Italy", JP="Japan", LT="Lithuania", LU="Luxembourg",
  LV="Latvia", NL="Netherlands", PL="Poland", PT="Portugal", RO="Romania",
  SE="Sweden", SI="Slovenia", UK="United Kingdom", US="United States"
)

g_country_hulten_A1B1 <-
  df_error_hulten_country_secondorder %>%
  filter(country %in% countries_A1B1) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  filter(year_initial == min(year_initial)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(country_label = coalesce(geo_names[country], country)) %>%
  left_join(df_quantiles_hulten_extented, by = 'horizon') %>%
  mutate(
    q10_band = pred_Ahat_1st + q10,
    q25_band = pred_Ahat_1st + q25,
    q75_band = pred_Ahat_1st + q75,
    q90_band = pred_Ahat_1st + q90
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q10_band, ymax = q90_band, fill = '[q10, q90]'), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25_band, ymax = q75_band, fill = '[q25, q75]'), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Ahat,          colour = 'Actual'),    lwd = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred_Ahat_1st, colour = '1st order'), lwd = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred_Ahat_2nd, colour = '2nd order'), lwd = 0.8, linetype = 'dashed') +
  facet_wrap(~country_label, scales = 'free') +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c('1st order' = '#003f5c', '2nd order' = 'forestgreen', 'Actual' = '#fc8d62')) +
  scale_fill_manual(values   = c('[q10, q90]' = 'lightblue', '[q25, q75]' = 'navy')) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1, big.mark = '')) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels  = scales::number_format(scale = 100, suffix = '%')) +
  mytheme +
  labs(x = 'Year', y = '', colour = '', fill = '') +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size=7),
    legend.position      = c(0.95, 0.00),
    legend.justification = c(1, 0),
    legend.margin        = margin(3, 5, 3, 5),
    legend.box           = 'horizontal',
    strip.text           = element_text(size = 8, face = 'bold'),
    axis.text            = element_text(size = 7)
  )
```

```{r}
hulten_y_scale <- scale_y_continuous(

# --- Comparison: 1st vs 2nd on the same axes -----------------------------
d1 <- df_error_KLEMS_hulten %>% filter(aggregation_order == "1st")%>%filter(horizon<=hulten_error_distribution_empirical_cutoff)
d2 <- df_error_KLEMS_hulten %>% filter(aggregation_order == "2nd")%>%filter(horizon<=hulten_error_distribution_empirical_cutoff)

col_1st <- "#1d91c0"
col_2nd <- "#e34a33"

# Custom legend glyphs: each row shows solid mean + band/dashed intervals
draw_key_1st <- function(data, params, size) {
  grid::grobTree(
    grid::rectGrob(x = 0.5, y = 0.5, width = 0.9, height = 0.5,
                   gp = grid::gpar(fill = scales::alpha(col_1st, 0.30), col = NA)),
    grid::linesGrob(x = c(0.05, 0.95), y = c(0.5, 0.5),
                    gp = grid::gpar(col = col_1st, lwd = 2, lty = 1))
  )
}

# Full version: solid mean + dotted q25/q75 + dashed q10/q90
draw_key_2nd <- function(data, params, size) {
  grid::grobTree(
    grid::linesGrob(x = c(0.05, 0.95), y = c(0.85, 0.85),
                    gp = grid::gpar(col = col_2nd, lwd = 0.8, lty = 2)),
    grid::linesGrob(x = c(0.05, 0.95), y = c(0.65, 0.65),
                    gp = grid::gpar(col = col_2nd, lwd = 1.0, lty = 3)),
    grid::linesGrob(x = c(0.05, 0.95), y = c(0.5,  0.5),
                    gp = grid::gpar(col = col_2nd, lwd = 2,   lty = 1)),
    grid::linesGrob(x = c(0.05, 0.95), y = c(0.35, 0.35),
                    gp = grid::gpar(col = col_2nd, lwd = 1.0, lty = 3)),
    grid::linesGrob(x = c(0.05, 0.95), y = c(0.15, 0.15),
                    gp = grid::gpar(col = col_2nd, lwd = 0.8, lty = 2))
  )
}

# Simple version: solid mean + dashed q10/q90 only
draw_key_2nd_simple <- function(data, params, size) {
  grid::grobTree(
    grid::linesGrob(x = c(0.05, 0.95), y = c(0.75, 0.75),
                    gp = grid::gpar(col = col_2nd, lwd = 0.8, lty = 2)),
    grid::linesGrob(x = c(0.05, 0.95), y = c(0.5,  0.5),
                    gp = grid::gpar(col = col_2nd, lwd = 2,   lty = 1)),
    grid::linesGrob(x = c(0.05, 0.95), y = c(0.25, 0.25),
                    gp = grid::gpar(col = col_2nd, lwd = 0.8, lty = 2))
  )
}

# Full version (q10/q90 + q25/q75) ----------------------------------------
g_error_hulten_1st_vs_2nd <-
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = horizon)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = d1, aes(ymin = q10, ymax = q90), fill = col_1st, alpha = 0.15, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_ribbon(data = d1, aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), fill = col_1st, alpha = 0.30, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = d1, aes(y = mean_error, colour = "1st order: mean (solid), bands (shaded)"),
            linetype = "solid", lwd = 1, key_glyph = draw_key_1st) +
  geom_line(data = d2, aes(y = q10),        colour = col_2nd, linetype = "dashed", lwd = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = d2, aes(y = q25),        colour = col_2nd, linetype = "dotted", lwd = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = d2, aes(y = q75),        colour = col_2nd, linetype = "dotted", lwd = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = d2, aes(y = q90),        colour = col_2nd, linetype = "dashed", lwd = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = d2, aes(y = mean_error, colour = "2nd order: mean (solid), [q25,q75] dotted, [q10,q90] dashed"),
            linetype = "solid", lwd = 1, key_glyph = draw_key_2nd) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "1st order: mean (solid), bands (shaded)"                        = col_1st,
    "2nd order: mean (solid), [q25,q75] dotted, [q10,q90] dashed"   = col_2nd
  ), name = "") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  hulten_y_scale +
  mytheme +
  labs(x = "Horizon", y = "Error: predicted - actual (pp)") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

g_error_hulten_1st_vs_2nd <- annotate_figure(
```

```{r}
# Group by country and summarise the sorted sector list as a single string
sector_sets <- df_STAN_Hulten%>%
  filter(!is.na(Aihat))%>%
  distinct(country, sector) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(sector_set = paste(sort(unique(sector)), collapse = ",")) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 0: Define and parse your sets
set_F1 <- unlist(strsplit(c(
  "D01,D02,D03,D05T09,D10T12,D13T15,D16,D17,D18,D19,D20,D21,D22,D23,D24,D25,D26,D27,D28,D29,D30,D31T32,D33,D35,D36,D37T39,D41T43,D45,D46,D47,D49,D50,D51,D52,D53,D55T56,D58,D59T60,D61,D62T63,D64,D65,D66,D68,D69T70,D71,D72,D73,D74T75,D77,D78,D79,D80T82,D84,D85,D86,D87T88,D90T92,D93,D94,D95,D96"), ","))
set_G1 <- unlist(strsplit(c(
  "D01T03,D05T09,D10T12,D13T15,D16T18,D19,D20,D21,D22T23,D24T25,D26,D27,D28,D29T30,D31T33,D35,D36T39,D41T43,D45T47,D49T53,D55T56,D58T60,D61,D62T63,D64T66,D68,D69T71,D72,D73T75,D77T82,D84,D85,D86,D87T88,D90T93,D94T96"), ","))
set_H1 <- unlist(strsplit(c(
   "D01T03,D05T09,D10T33,D35T39,D41T43,D45T82,D84T99"), ","))
set_I1 <- unlist(strsplit(c(
   "D01T03,D05T09,D35T39,D41T43,D45T47,D49T53,D55T56,D58T63,D64T66,D68,D69T75,D84,D85,D86T88,D90T93,D90T99,D94T96"), ",")) #missing D10T33




sector_sets_classified <- sector_sets %>%
  mutate(
    sector_vec = strsplit(sector_set, ","),
    classification = sapply(sector_vec, function(sectors) {
      if (all(set_F1 %in% sectors)) {
        "F1"
      } else if (all(set_G1 %in% sectors)) {
        "G1"
      } else if (all(set_H1 %in% sectors)) {
        "H1"
      } else if (all(set_I1 %in% sectors)) {
        "I1"
      # } else if (all(set_E1 %in% sectors)) {
      #   "E1"
      } else {
        "other"
      }
    })
  )%>%
  select(country,classification)
```

```{r}
  labs(linetype="",
```

GVA - volumes (CVM) and value (CP)

Aggregated at the first digit SIC level, 20 industries (A to T)\
Available at the 3 digits (e.g. A01 or R91, R92, R93) for 106 industries if necessary
```{r, echo=F,warning=F}
# at the SIC level (20 industries)
supply_use_Industry_SIC<-
  supply_use_Industry %>%
  select(-Industry)%>%
   gather(key=Year,value=value,-c(1:3))%>%
  mutate(SIC=str_sub(`Industry SIC Code`,1,1))%>%
  mutate(SIC=ifelse(SIC=="_","TOTAL",SIC))%>%
  mutate(value=as.numeric(as.character(value)),
         Year=as.numeric(Year))%>%
  select(-`Industry SIC Code`)

SUT<-
 supply_use_Industry_SIC %>%
  filter(!Price=="CVM")%>%
  group_by(Price,Year,SIC,Component)%>%
  summarise("value"=sum(value))


# Base year = 2019, recursive formula
### 2019 CVM=CP
### 2019 CVM=PYP
SUT_CVM<-SUT %>%
  spread(key=Price,value=value)%>%
  mutate(CVM=ifelse(Year==2019,CP,ifelse(Year==2020,PYP,NA)))%>%
  ungroup()

SUT_CVM_recursif<-
  SUT_CVM%>%
  filter(Year>=2019)%>%
  select(Year,SIC, Component,CVM)
for(t in 2018:1997){
  head_CVM<-
    SUT_CVM_recursif%>%
    filter(Year==t+1)%>%
    select(SIC, Component,CVM)%>%
    rename("head_CVM"="CVM")
  
  head_PYP<-
    SUT_CVM%>%
    filter(Year==t+1)%>%
    select(SIC, Component,PYP)%>%
    rename("head_PYP"="PYP")
  
  SUT_CVM_t<-
  SUT_CVM%>%
  filter(Year==t)%>%
    select(SIC, Component,CP)%>%
    group_by(SIC, Component)%>%
    left_join(head_CVM,by=c("SIC","Component"))%>%
    left_join(head_PYP,by=c("SIC","Component"))%>%
  mutate(CVM=head_CVM/(head_PYP/CP))%>%
    mutate(Year=t)%>%
    select(Year,SIC, Component,CVM)
  
  SUT_CVM_recursif<-rbind(SUT_CVM_recursif,SUT_CVM_t)
}
```

## UK economy - facts


For the UK, max horizon is 17Y, between 2000 and 2017
Xihat and pihat are growth rates between 2000 and 2017
Share of VA, domar, GDP are in 2017
```{r}


facts_part_economy<-function(c_sectors,name){
  
  df<-
    df_KLEMS_Hulten%>%
  filter(country=="UK")%>%
  mutate(ind_sector=ifelse(sector %in% c_sectors,1,0))%>%
  mutate(indus=name)%>%
  group_by(sector)%>%
  mutate(log_change_GO = log(GO_Q) - log(lag(GO_Q,17)),
         log_change_P = log(GO_PI) - log(lag(GO_PI,17)))%>%
  filter(Year==max(Year))%>%
 group_by(indus)%>%
  summarise("domar"=sum(domar_weight*ind_sector)/sum(domar_weight),
            "GDP_cp"=sum(gdp_CP*ind_sector)/sum(gdp_CP),
            "VA_CP"=sum(VA_CP*ind_sector)/sum(VA_CP),
            "Xihat"=weighted.mean(log_change_GO,GO_Q*ind_sector,na.rm=T),
            "pihat"=weighted.mean(log_change_P,GO_Q*ind_sector,na.rm=T),
            "sales"=sum(GO_CP*ind_sector),
            "shat"=Xihat+pihat
            )
    
}

 df_KLEMS_Hulten%>%
  filter(country=="UK")%>%
   ungroup()%>%
   select(sector,sector_name)%>%
   distinct()

 # NB: we include Transportation in the Manufacturing
df_UK_manuf<-facts_part_economy(LETTERS[c(1:6,8)],"Manufacturing")
df_UK_services<-facts_part_economy(LETTERS[c(7,9:26)],"Services")
df_UK_tot<-facts_part_economy(LETTERS[1:26],"All")
 

rbind(df_UK_manuf,
     df_UK_services,
     df_UK_tot)
  
```
